text:
Nora P.: Heads up @people-ops - my March paycheck shows Irish PRSI deducted but I submitted an A1 certificate before my secondment start (2025-02-01). I shouldn’t be subject to Irish social security. Net is down about €220.
Sophia (People Ops): Sorry Nora. Can you drop EmpID or screenshot of the payline so payroll can pull the run?
Nora P.: EmpID 9210. Paystub snippet copied:
```
Payrun: 2025-03-31
EmpID: 9210
Location: Dublin secondment (start 2025-02-01)
PRSI (Irish social security): 4.5% €220.00
Net pay: €4,730.00
```
Payroll Bot: Ticket created: PAY-5588 assigned to @Diego (Payroll). ETA initial look in 1 business day.
Diego (Payroll): I pulled run 20250331. Payroll system shows tax jurisdiction IRL-PRSI applied. Our records did not have an uploaded A1 certificate flag at time of file creation.
Global Mobility: We received Nora's A1 on 2025-01-20 and uploaded it to the mobility tracker, but looks like the HR -> Payroll sync did not carry the certificate attachment. We'll re-send the cert and check the connector logs.
Diego (Payroll): Plan: 1) submit reversal for the PRSI withholding to restore net pay (if remittance to Irish Revenue not yet sent) 2) if remitted, process off-cycle payroll credit and start reclaim with Irish Revenue 3) document for end-of-year Irish P60 and US payroll records (no US FICA change expected).
Tax Team: Quick note: A1 exemption means employer and employee are covered under home country social security. If Irish PRSI was remitted, reclaim can be requested from Revenue Commissioners but timeframe varies; payroll credit is usually fastest for employee experience. Also check if employer contribution portion was remitted — that affects reclaim process.
Benefits: Check pension enrollment side effects. If PRSI is reversed we need to confirm statutory pension deductions or employer contributions in Ireland were not erroneously processed.
Legal: Reminder: keep copies of A1 and reclaim correspondence for audit. If we end up issuing a credit, include a memo referencing PAY-5588 and the cert date.
Diego (Payroll): Action items:
- Re-send A1 to payroll system and attach to employee record (Global Mobility)
- Check bank remittance window for Irish PAYE/PRSI for period 2025-03 (Payroll)
- If remittance not sent, schedule reversal and re-run payroll; if sent, schedule off-cycle credit and start reclaim (Tax)
ETA: I’ll confirm status by EOD tomorrow.
Nora P.: Thanks - I’d prefer the payroll credit if remittance already went. Please cc me on PAY-5588.
Sophia (People Ops): Noted. I’ll keep Nora looped and follow up with Global Mobility to ensure connector backfill doesn’t affect other secondments.
Diego (Payroll): Update: bank remittance for Irish liabilities is pending for 2025-03 (window closes 2025-04-02). I’m submitting the reversal now so we can avoid remittance. Will post confirmation when reversal posts.
Nora P.: Really appreciate the quick action, thanks everyone.
